eyebrow: One chain, in order, every night

steps.label: Extract
steps.sub: SQL Server to Snowflake raw -- memberships, billing, locations

steps.label: dbt run
steps.sub: builds staging through the marts, only after extraction succeeds

steps.label: dbt test
steps.sub: runs only after the models actually built -- never against stale data

code:
with DAG(
    dag_id="brightleaf_nightly_pipeline",
    schedule_interval="0 2 * * *",
    catchup=False,
    max_active_runs=1,
) as dag:

    extract_sql_server >> dbt_run >> dbt_test
caption: 2am, after SQL Server's own batch jobs close out -- never two nights overlapping.

code:
alert_pipeline_failure = EmailOperator(
    task_id="alert_pipeline_failure",
    trigger_rule=TriggerRule.ONE_FAILED,
    ...
)

[extract_sql_server, dbt_run, dbt_test] >> alert_pipeline_failure
caption: A failure anywhere in the chain reaches a human -- the marts just keep yesterday's data until it's fixed.
